_README: Client supplied overrides, keyed by the product id from the WooCommerce export. Anything here wins over the CSV. Run `npm run ingest` after editing. Keys: title (plain text), slug (url segment), description (HTML, sanitised on import to a tag allowlist with no attributes except href and title). See docs/CLIENT-ACTIONS.md section 6 and data/reports/content-gaps.csv for the list of products that need attention.

4769.title: Glock 19 Gen5 9mm Pistol - Compact 15 Round
4769.description:
Glock 19 Gen5 9mm compact pistol. Frame without finger grooves, Modular Backstrap System, reversible magazine catch, ambidextrous slide stop lever, Glock Marksman Barrel with recessed crown, nDLC finish, front serrations.

  • Caliber: 9x19mm
  • System: Safe Action
  • Magazine capacity: Standard 15, optional 17 / 24 / 31 / 33
  • Barrel length: 102 mm | 4.02 inch
  • Overall length: 185 mm | 7.28 inch
  • Slide length: 174 mm | 6.85 inch
  • Width overall: 34 mm | 1.34 inch
  • Slide width: 25.5 mm | 1.00 inch
  • Height incl mag: 128 mm | 5.04 inch
  • Line of sight: Polymer 153 mm | 6.02 inch, Steel 152 mm | 5.98 inch, GNS 151 mm | 5.94 inch
  • Trigger distance: 70 mm | 2.76 inch
  • Trigger pull: 26 N | 5.5 lb
  • Weight without magazine: 610 g | 21.52 oz
  • Weight with empty magazine: 670 g | 23.63 oz
  • Weight with loaded magazine: 855 g | 30.16 oz

Ships with two magazines. Specs from Glock official data for G19 Gen5.
